summary: Grab Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting its Q1 2026 earnings and disclosing share repurchase activity. In March 2026, the company entered into an accelerated share repurchase agreement for $250 million and a contingent forward purchase agreement for up to $150 million of Class A ordinary shares, under a previously announced $500 million buyback program approved by the board in February 2026. No premium, price, or advisor was specified. The program reduces share count and signals capital return to shareholders. Watch for execution pace and impact on diluted EPS amid ongoing revenue growth of 24% YoY.
